Ahmed's diary

I'm just a poor boy living in a shanty town. My parents are kind and loving, but we barely survive. We live in a makeshift shack, with no running water or electricity. My sister, Amira, and I share a single room, and we have to sleep on the floor.

We always struggle to make ends meet, but things get even tougher when a powerful country declares war on our country. My parents are killed in a plane bombing, leaving us alone to fend for ourselves.

We're forced to flee our home and seek shelter in an abandoned building. The winter is cold and we have no blankets, but we manage to survive thanks to the generosity of strangers.

We spend the next few years struggling to find food and shelter amidst the chaos of the war. We're constantly on the move, trying to stay one step ahead of the fighting.

Despite all the hardships we face, Amira and I remain close. We share everything we have and support each other through the tough times.

But our luck begins to run out when Amira falls ill with a severe fever. She gets worse and worse, and we're powerless to help her. She dies in my arms, and I'm heartbroken.

After Amira's death, I'm left alone to face the world. I feel like giving up, but I know I have to keep going for her. I start to dream of a better future, where I'm not alone and where I can live in peace.

I try my best to survive, but the memories of Amira and my parents always haunt me. I spend the next year doing whatever I can to make ends meet, but I can't shake the feeling that I'll never be able to escape the past.

In the end, I die in my sleep, never having achieved my dreams. But I know that Amira will always be with me, in my heart and in my memories.
